name: CHIONANTHUS VIRGINICA
key_symptoms: Listless, apathetic. Dull frontal headache, over root of nose, over eyes, through temples, worse stooping, motion, jar. Yellow conjunctiva.
guiding_symptoms: Listless, apathetic. Dull frontal headache, over root of nose, over eyes, through temples, worse stooping, motion, jar. Yellow conjunctiva.
head_symptoms: Listless, apathetic. Dull frontal headache, over root of nose, over eyes, through temples, worse stooping, motion, jar. Yellow conjunctiva.
skin_symptoms: Yellow; marked moisture of skin. Sallow, greenish, itching.
